description: Regression for the serve-mode 'session terminates early' bug. The model emits a SYNTACTICALLY COMPLETE cpp code block (closing fence present, size large enough to dodge the placeholder/size guards) but NEVER emits a hard terminal event. The transport then closes via server.disconnect. Under the new contract the session MUST NOT write this code-block to disk: without a hard terminal the model is not actually done, and the candidate patch may be partial/wrong. The original file must be preserved.
